approval_basis: Repository-owner review of the combined v29 prefix-scan and QSA Compiler evolution Gate. The exact Gate 3799be5163a270cacfcd949e529da3f44fac2b51a62eba59cd67d9bc6de0871e matches 54 of 54 cases across 72 bound sources. The prior 37 cases retain their accepted/lowering decisions, finding codes, Schedule identities, and lowering-source identities. New general capabilities are limited to scan, explicit cast, ReLU, loop-carried Top-K, affine index expansion, query-derived loop stops, FP32 IEEE dot, and explicit online-softmax state/validity; no QSA-named compiler black box was added. Five independently analyzable QSA Schedules compose one frozen logical program ABI. Negative cases prove the new dtype, shape, axis, and placement boundaries fail closed. Relevant non-released-lock contracts passed 144 tests. This approval authorizes only the Compiler Revision and makes no GPU correctness, performance, checkpoint, serving, or matched-arm claim.
